subject: {Invitation} AI Execs Dinner @ Maison de l'Amérique Latine, Paris
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI is hosting a private dinner with a small group of AI leaders and customers, and we'd love to invite you to join.

The evening will bring together Directors of Computer Vision, VPs of AI from companies like AXA and Sanofi, as well as CEOs and CTOs of fast-growing startups such as Deepomatic and Scortex.

📍 Maison de L'Amérique Latine
📅 Tuesday, 21st May
🕖 From 7:00 PM
We've reserved a private dining room for ~20 guests, so the setting will be relaxed and conversational.

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we've built an end-to-end data development platform for ML teams, working with companies like AXA, EuroControl, and Moon Surgical. We recently raised $50M from CRV and Y Combinator to continue scaling.

Spots are limited and confirmed on a first-come basis - please RSVP if you'd like to join.

Au plaisir,
